introduction: The PR Feedback Loop extends the nightshift autonomous coding agent to monitor open pull requests after creation, detect CI failures and reviewer change requests, and iteratively re-run the coder with failure context injected — closing the loop between PR creation and merge without human intervention.

glossary.CheckResult: Type returned by get_pr_checks representing a single CI check with name, status, conclusion, output_title, and output_summary fields
glossary.DaemonRunner: Class in daemon.py that manages the priority-ordered execution of named work streams
glossary.EngineWorkStream: Class in streams.py that wraps an async engine method and fires it on a configured interval as part of the nightshift scheduling loop
glossary.FixPipeline: Class in fix_pipeline.py whose methods (_build_coder_prompt, _run_coder_session, _auto_commit_pending_changes) are called by pr_feedback.py via composition
glossary.IssueComment: Type returned by list_issue_comments representing a single issue comment with body field
glossary.IssueResult: Type returned by list_issues_by_label representing a single GitHub issue with number, title, body, and label fields
glossary.LABEL_FIXED: Constant string 'af:fixed' from afissues.labels used when closing a merged PR issue
glossary.LABEL_PR: Constant string 'af:pr' from afissues.labels used to query and manipulate the PR-monitoring label
glossary.NightShiftConfig: Pydantic v2 model in config.py holding all nightshift configuration fields including the new pr_check_interval and max_pr_retries
glossary.NightShiftEngine: Core engine class in engine.py to which _check_open_prs() is added as an async dispatcher method
glossary.NightShiftState: Dataclass in engine.py holding runtime counters for the nightshift daemon; issue_checks_completed is incremented per processed PR issue
glossary.PR_TRACKING_PATTERN: Compiled regex pattern imported from fix_pipeline.py (spec 06) used to identify and parse nightshift tracking comments on issues
glossary.PlatformProtocol: Protocol interface in afissues.protocol defining async methods for interacting with the code hosting platform (GitHub)
glossary.PrState: Type returned by get_pr_state containing merged (bool) and state (str) fields describing the current state of a pull request
glossary.ReviewComment: Type returned by get_pr_reviews representing a single PR review with user, body, and state fields
glossary.TriageResult: Frozen dataclass from fix_pipeline.py representing the triage analysis of an issue; synthetic instances are constructed for feedback re-entry
glossary.WorkspaceConfig: Pydantic model in config.py holding workspace settings including merge_strategy and integration_branch
glossary._MAX_PR_CHECKS: Hardcoded constant (value 5) in engine.py that caps the number of issues processed per poll cycle in _check_open_prs()
glossary._auto_commit_pending_changes: FixPipeline helper that stages and commits all pending changes in the worktree with a given commit message
glossary._build_coder_prompt: FixPipeline method that constructs the system and task prompts for a coder session given a triage result and optional review feedback
glossary._check_open_prs: Async method on NightShiftEngine that lists open af:pr issues and dispatches each to process_pr_issue() sequentially
glossary._cleanup_feedback_worktree: Function in pr_feedback.py that removes the feedback worktree directory; silently no-ops if the directory does not exist
glossary._collect_feedback: Function in pr_feedback.py that formats CI failure details or review comments as a markdown string for injection as review_feedback
glossary._run_coder_session: Async FixPipeline method that executes a coder agent session in a given workspace
glossary._run_feedback_iteration: Function in pr_feedback.py that orchestrates the full feedback re-entry sequence: fetch, worktree, coder session, tracking comment, force-push, cleanup
glossary._setup_feedback_worktree: Function in pr_feedback.py that runs git fetch then git worktree add for the fix branch at worktrees/feedback-{issue_number}
glossary.af:fix: GitHub issue label applied by nightshift when an issue is queued for automated fixing via the fix pipeline
glossary.af:fixed: GitHub issue label applied by nightshift when a pull request has been merged and the originating issue is considered resolved
glossary.af:pr: GitHub issue label applied by nightshift when a pull request has been created for the issue, indicating the issue is in PR-monitoring state
glossary.attempt: Integer counter embedded in the tracking comment indicating how many times nightshift has pushed to this PR (1 = original, 2+ = feedback iterations)
glossary.build_streams: Function in streams.py that constructs and returns the list of EngineWorkStream instances including the new pr-feedback stream
glossary.feedback worktree: Git worktree created by _setup_feedback_worktree() at worktrees/feedback-{issue_number} on the fix branch for a feedback iteration
glossary.fix branch: Git branch named fix/{issue_number}-{slug} created by the fix pipeline for a specific issue; the branch nightshift force-pushes to during feedback iterations
glossary.fix_pipeline: Module agentfox/nightshift/fix_pipeline.py containing the FixPipeline class and tracking comment utilities introduced by spec 06
glossary.format_tracking_comment: Function imported from fix_pipeline.py that renders a new tracking comment string with updated pr_number, attempt, pr_url, and message
glossary.integration_branch: WorkspaceConfig field naming the base branch against which the fix branch is diffed to compute affected_files
glossary.issue_checks_completed: Field on NightShiftState incremented by _check_open_prs() each time an issue is processed in a poll cycle
glossary.knowledge_context: Parameter of _build_coder_prompt() carrying retrieved knowledge; passed as empty string for feedback re-entry
glossary.max_pr_retries: NightShiftConfig field controlling the maximum number of feedback iterations allowed per PR before requiring manual attention
glossary.merge_strategy: WorkspaceConfig field controlling how nightshift submits fixes; the pr-feedback stream is only enabled when this equals 'pr'
glossary.parse_tracking_comment: Function imported from fix_pipeline.py that extracts pr_number and attempt from a tracking comment body
glossary.pr-feedback: The name of the work stream entry added to the nightshift scheduler that periodically polls open pull requests for state changes
glossary.pr_check_interval: NightShiftConfig field controlling the number of seconds between PR status poll cycles (minimum 60)
glossary.pr_feedback: New module agentfox/nightshift/pr_feedback.py containing all PR monitoring and feedback re-entry logic defined by this spec
glossary.prior_context: Parameter of _build_coder_prompt() carrying prior attempt context; passed as empty string for feedback re-entry
glossary.process_pr_issue: Main entry point in pr_feedback.py that orchestrates the full PR check and feedback re-entry flow for a single issue
glossary.review_feedback: Parameter passed to _build_coder_prompt() containing the formatted markdown string of CI failures or review comments for the coder to address
glossary.sanitise_branch_name: Function from spec_builder.py that converts an issue title and number into a valid git branch name slug
glossary.worktrees: Directory under the nightshift working root where git worktrees for both fix pipeline and feedback iterations are created

user_story.goal: configure how frequently PRs are polled and how many feedback iterations are allowed
user_story.benefit: tune the feedback loop for my team's CI speed and risk tolerance

acceptance_criteria.action: exposes a `pr_check_interval` integer field with default value 900 and a Pydantic v2 validator that clamps the value to a minimum of 60, following the same pattern as the existing clamp_interval_minimum validator
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: field reads back the clamped integer value; values below 60 are silently raised to 60

acceptance_criteria.action: exposes a `max_pr_retries` integer field with default value 2 and a Pydantic v2 validator that clamps the value to the inclusive range [0, 10]
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: field reads back the clamped integer value; values below 0 are raised to 0, values above 10 are lowered to 10

edge_cases.action: clamps the stored value to 60 without raising a validation error
edge_cases.return_contract: field value is 60
edge_cases.error_condition: `pr_check_interval` is set to a value below 60 (e.g., 30)

edge_cases.action: clamps the stored value to the nearest boundary without raising a validation error
edge_cases.return_contract: field value is 0 for -1 input, 10 for 15 input
edge_cases.error_condition: `max_pr_retries` is set to a value outside [0, 10] (e.g., -1 or 15)

user_story.goal: run PR monitoring as a lower-priority background stream
user_story.benefit: existing PR issues are checked regularly without blocking new issue fixing

acceptance_criteria.action: includes a `"pr-feedback"` `EngineWorkStream` wrapping `_check_open_prs` with interval set to `pr_check_interval`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returned stream list contains the pr-feedback entry at a position after the fix-pipeline entry
acceptance_criteria.state: `merge_strategy` is 'pr' and the platform type is not 'none'

acceptance_criteria.action: does not include a `"pr-feedback"` `EngineWorkStream` in the returned list
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returned stream list contains no entry named pr-feedback
acceptance_criteria.state: `merge_strategy` is not 'pr' or the platform type is 'none'

acceptance_criteria.action: places `"pr-feedback"` after `"fix-pipeline"` in the priority order list so that new issue fixes take precedence over PR monitoring

user_story.goal: list and process open af:pr issues on each poll cycle
user_story.benefit: PR state changes are detected and acted on without human monitoring

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `platform.list_issues_by_label(LABEL_PR)` with default oldest-first ordering and caps the result to the first `_MAX_PR_CHECKS` (5) issues, then sequentially awaits `process_pr_issue()` for each, incrementing `issue_checks_completed` after each call
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; issues beyond the cap are deferred to the next cycle

acceptance_criteria.action: is declared as `async def _check_open_prs(self) -> None` and awaits each `process_pr_issue()` call sequentially without concurrent gather
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: no concurrent worktree creation occurs across issues in a single poll cycle

acceptance_criteria.action: defines `_MAX_PR_CHECKS = 5` as a module-level constant adjacent to `_check_open_prs()`, not inside `pr_feedback.py`

edge_cases.action: processes only the first 5 issues in oldest-first order; remaining issues are not processed in this cycle
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; no error is raised for the deferred issues

edge_cases.action: does nothing and returns immediately
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; `issue_checks_completed` is not incremented

requirements.title: Tracking comment parsing for PR issue

user_story.goal: extract the PR number and attempt count from the issue's tracking comment
user_story.benefit: subsequent PR state checks and retry limit enforcement use accurate metadata

acceptance_criteria.action: lists issue comments via `platform.list_issue_comments(issue.number)`, finds the last comment in list order matching `PR_TRACKING_PATTERN`, and extracts `pr_number` and `attempt` using `parse_tracking_comment`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: extracted pr_number (int) and attempt (int) are used for subsequent steps; function returns None on success

acceptance_criteria.action: logs a WARNING with the issue number and skips the issue without modifying any labels or posting any comment
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; `af:pr` label remains on the issue for retry on the next poll cycle
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: no comment matches `PR_TRACKING_PATTERN` or `parse_tracking_comment` returns None (malformed comment)

edge_cases.action: uses the last matching item in the list (oldest-first API ordering) as the most recent tracking comment
edge_cases.return_contract: pr_number and attempt are extracted from the last matching comment

edge_cases.action: logs a WARNING with the issue number and exception message, skips the issue, leaves all labels intact
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; no comment is posted to the issue

requirements.title: PR state detection and label transitions

user_story.goal: detect merged and closed PRs and update issue state accordingly
user_story.benefit: merged issues are automatically closed and labelled as fixed without human intervention

acceptance_criteria.action: sequentially calls `platform.assign_label(issue.number, LABEL_FIXED)`, `platform.remove_label(issue.number, LABEL_PR)`, `platform.close_issue(issue.number, 'PR #{pr_number} merged.')`, then logs at INFO
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; issue is closed with af:fixed label and no af:pr label

acceptance_criteria.action: posts comment 'PR #{pr_number} was closed without merging. Removing af:pr label for manual triage.', calls `platform.remove_label(issue.number, LABEL_PR)`, leaves the issue open, logs at INFO
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; issue remains open without af:pr label

acceptance_criteria.action: continues to CI check step without modifying labels or posting comments
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: proceeds to `_check_ci_status` step

edge_cases.action: logs a WARNING with the issue number, PR number, and exception message; skips the issue; leaves all labels intact; posts no comment
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; af:pr label remains for retry on the next poll cycle

edge_cases.action: logs a WARNING and skips the issue for this cycle; on the next poll cycle all three operations are re-applied in order — already-completed steps are idempotent no-ops at the GitHub API level
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; issue retried next cycle with no data corruption
edge_cases.error_condition: a platform API exception is raised mid-sequence during merged PR label transition (e.g., `assign_label` succeeds but `close_issue` raises)

user_story.goal: determine whether CI results warrant a feedback re-entry or a wait
user_story.benefit: the coder is only re-invoked for actionable failures, preventing wasted cycles

acceptance_criteria.action: skips the issue and waits for the next poll cycle without logging at WARNING or ERROR
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a skip signal; no re-entry is triggered

acceptance_criteria.action: triggers feedback re-entry and logs at INFO: 'Re-entry triggered for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: CI failure/timeout.'
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a re-entry signal with the list of failed/timed-out CheckResult items

acceptance_criteria.action: skips the issue and logs at WARNING: 'Skipped issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: all checks in ambiguous state (cancelled/action_required/stale).'
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a skip signal; no re-entry is triggered
acceptance_criteria.trigger: all checks have `conclusion` in {'cancelled', 'action_required', 'stale'} with none having `conclusion == 'success'`

acceptance_criteria.action: proceeds to the review check step
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a pass-through signal to _check_reviews

acceptance_criteria.action: treats the absence of CI as equivalent to all passing and proceeds to the review check step
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a pass-through signal to _check_reviews
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the check list returned by `platform.get_pr_checks(pr_number)` is empty

edge_cases.action: triggers feedback re-entry because at least one check has a failure conclusion
edge_cases.return_contract: returns a re-entry signal; INFO logged
edge_cases.trigger: the check list contains a mix of 'success' and 'failure' conclusions

edge_cases.action: logs a WARNING with the issue number, PR number, and exception message; skips the issue; leaves all labels intact
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; af:pr label remains for retry on the next poll cycle

edge_cases.action: treats the check as in an ambiguous state (does not treat it as success or failure); logs a WARNING if all checks are in this ambiguous state
edge_cases.return_contract: does not trigger re-entry based on a null conclusion
edge_cases.error_condition: `platform.get_pr_checks` returns a `CheckResult` with a null or missing `conclusion` field

user_story.goal: detect reviewer change requests and trigger feedback re-entry
user_story.benefit: reviewer feedback is addressed automatically without human forwarding

acceptance_criteria.action: triggers feedback re-entry and logs at INFO: 'Re-entry triggered for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: reviewer requested changes.'
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a re-entry signal with the list of active ReviewComment items

acceptance_criteria.action: skips the issue — the PR is healthy and awaiting a human merge decision
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a skip signal; no re-entry triggered
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the latest non-dismissed review has `state == 'APPROVED'` or `state == 'COMMENTED'`, or there are no non-dismissed reviews

acceptance_criteria.action: filters out all `ReviewComment` entries with `state == 'DISMISSED'` before determining the latest active review state
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: dismissed reviews have no effect on the re-entry decision

edge_cases.action: logs a WARNING with the issue number, PR number, and exception message; skips the issue; leaves all labels intact
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; af:pr label remains for retry on the next poll cycle

edge_cases.action: treats the review list as empty and skips the issue
edge_cases.return_contract: returns a skip signal; no re-entry triggered

edge_cases.action: does not count the malformed entry as CHANGES_REQUESTED; treats it as non-triggering
edge_cases.return_contract: no re-entry triggered based on a null state field
edge_cases.error_condition: `platform.get_pr_reviews` returns a `ReviewComment` with a null or missing `state` field

user_story.goal: prevent the feedback loop from retrying indefinitely on a PR that the coder cannot fix
user_story.benefit: stalled PRs surface for human attention rather than consuming resources in a loop

acceptance_criteria.action: logs at INFO: 'Retry limit reached for issue #{n}, PR #{pr} (attempt {attempt}/{max_pr_retries + 1}). Needs manual attention.' and posts the _RETRY_LIMIT_MESSAGE comment to the issue; leaves `af:pr` label in place; does not run the coder
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; no worktree is created; af:pr label remains
acceptance_criteria.trigger: `attempt` parsed from the tracking comment is greater than `config.night_shift.max_pr_retries`

acceptance_criteria.action: proceeds with the full feedback iteration: fetch, worktree creation, coder session, tracking comment, force-push
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None after completing or encountering an error in the iteration
acceptance_criteria.trigger: `attempt` is less than or equal to `config.night_shift.max_pr_retries`

edge_cases.action: evaluates 1 > 0 as True, stops immediately with the retry limit message and INFO log; no feedback iteration runs
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; no worktree is created
edge_cases.trigger: `max_pr_retries` is 0 and the first feedback trigger fires with `attempt == 1`

edge_cases.action: re-entry runs; on the second feedback iteration (attempt=2) the incremented counter posted becomes 3, and any subsequent trigger with attempt=3 will halt
edge_cases.return_contract: up to 2 feedback iterations execute; 3rd trigger stops with retry limit message

user_story.goal: create and clean up a git worktree for each feedback iteration
user_story.benefit: the coder has an isolated workspace on the fix branch without interfering with other operations

acceptance_criteria.action: first runs `git fetch origin <branch>` where branch is derived via `sanitise_branch_name(issue.title, issue.number)`, then runs `git worktree add worktrees/feedback-{issue.number} <branch>` targeting the fix branch HEAD
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns the worktree path string on success; raises an exception on fetch or worktree add failure

acceptance_criteria.action: removes the worktree directory at `worktrees/feedback-{issue_number}`; if the directory does not exist, silently no-ops and logs at DEBUG: 'Feedback worktree not found for issue #{n} — skipping cleanup.'
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; never raises an exception regardless of directory existence
acceptance_criteria.trigger: called in a finally block during or after a feedback iteration

edge_cases.action: treats the failure as a worktree creation error: logs at ERROR, does not attempt `git worktree add`; `_cleanup_feedback_worktree` is called in the finally block and silently no-ops since no directory was created
edge_cases.return_contract: raises an exception; issue is skipped for this cycle; af:pr label remains
edge_cases.error_condition: `git fetch origin <branch>` fails due to network error or branch not found on origin

edge_cases.action: logs at ERROR; `_cleanup_feedback_worktree` is called in the finally block and silently no-ops since the directory was not created
edge_cases.return_contract: raises an exception; issue is skipped for this cycle; af:pr label remains
edge_cases.error_condition: `git worktree add` fails after a successful fetch (e.g., disk space exhaustion or branch name conflict)

edge_cases.action: the subprocess call must be wrapped with a timeout; if the timeout fires, the subprocess is terminated, an exception is raised, and the finally block calls `_cleanup_feedback_worktree`
edge_cases.return_contract: raises a timeout exception; issue is skipped for this cycle
edge_cases.error_condition: a git subprocess hangs and does not return

user_story.goal: format CI failures or review comments as structured markdown for the coder
user_story.benefit: the coder receives precise, actionable context for the re-coding session

acceptance_criteria.action: formats the `ci_failures` list under a `## CI Failures` heading, including each `CheckResult`'s `name`, `output_title`, and `output_summary` fields; produces no `## Review Feedback` section
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a non-empty markdown string containing exactly one section headed '## CI Failures'

acceptance_criteria.action: formats the `review_comments` list under a `## Review Feedback` heading, including each `ReviewComment`'s `user`, `body`, and `state` fields; produces no `## CI Failures` section
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a non-empty markdown string containing exactly one section headed '## Review Feedback'

acceptance_criteria.action: accepts signature `(trigger: Literal['ci', 'review'], ci_failures: list[CheckResult], review_comments: list[ReviewComment]) -> str` and always formats exactly one section, since CI and review re-entry paths are mutually exclusive
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a str; never combines both sections in a single output

requirements.title: Coder session invocation during feedback re-entry

user_story.goal: re-run the coder with failure context on the fix branch
user_story.benefit: the coder can address CI failures or reviewer changes autonomously

acceptance_criteria.action: constructs a synthetic `TriageResult` with `summary=issue.title`, `affected_files` from `git diff --name-only <integration_branch> <fix_branch>` run in the feedback worktree, `criteria=[]`, `assessed_complexity=None`, `issue_body=issue.body`; then calls `pipeline._build_coder_prompt(spec, triage, review_feedback=<collected_feedback>, prior_context='', knowledge_context='')`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: coder prompt is constructed with the review_feedback parameter populated and prior_context and knowledge_context both empty strings

acceptance_criteria.action: invokes `pipeline._run_coder_session()` with the feedback worktree workspace and the same model ID used by the original fix pipeline (read from the nightshift model configuration)
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: awaits the coder session coroutine; returns the session result object

acceptance_criteria.action: defaults `affected_files` to an empty list and logs a WARNING: 'git diff --name-only failed for issue #{n}, PR #{pr} — defaulting affected_files to [].'
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: coder session proceeds with affected_files=[]
acceptance_criteria.trigger: `git diff --name-only <integration_branch> <fix_branch>` fails or returns empty output

edge_cases.action: logs at ERROR: 'Error in feedback iteration for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: coder session raised — {exc}.'; skips the issue for this cycle; calls `_cleanup_feedback_worktree` in the finally block; leaves all labels intact
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; af:pr label remains on the issue

edge_cases.action: the calling coroutine must propagate the asyncio CancelledError or timeout exception; the finally block calls `_cleanup_feedback_worktree`; ERROR is logged
edge_cases.return_contract: exception propagated; issue skipped; worktree cleaned up
edge_cases.error_condition: `pipeline._run_coder_session` does not return within a reasonable timeout

user_story.goal: persist the incremented attempt counter before pushing changes
user_story.benefit: the retry count is never lost even if the push fails, preventing indefinite re-triggering

acceptance_criteria.action: posts an updated tracking comment using `format_tracking_comment(pr_number=pr_number, attempt=attempt+1, pr_url='', message=_FEEDBACK_ITERATION_MESSAGE.format(attempt=attempt+1))` via `platform.add_issue_comment(issue.number, comment)`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: tracking comment is posted to the issue before any diff check or force-push; `add_issue_comment` returns None on success
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the coder session completes and before computing the diff

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `pipeline._auto_commit_pending_changes()` with commit message `_FEEDBACK_COMMIT_MESSAGE.format(issue_title=issue.title, attempt=attempt+1)`, then runs `git push --force` on the fix branch to origin
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: PR is updated with new commits; logs at INFO: 'Feedback iteration {attempt+1} complete for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}.'
acceptance_criteria.trigger: tracking comment is posted successfully and the coder produced file changes (non-empty diff)

acceptance_criteria.action: skips the force-push; posts a _NO_CHANGES_MESSAGE comment to the issue; logs at WARNING; the attempt counter is already incremented in the tracking comment
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None after cleanup; no force-push is executed
acceptance_criteria.trigger: tracking comment is posted successfully and the coder produced an empty diff

edge_cases.action: logs at ERROR: 'Error in feedback iteration for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: failed to post tracking comment — {exc}.'; skips the force-push; calls `_cleanup_feedback_worktree` in the finally block; old attempt counter remains on the issue
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; af:pr label remains; next poll cycle re-triggers with the original counter

edge_cases.action: logs at ERROR: 'Error in feedback iteration for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: git push --force failed — {exc}.'; calls `_cleanup_feedback_worktree` in the finally block; the incremented counter remains persisted in the tracking comment
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; af:pr label remains; next cycle retries with the incremented counter or halts at the limit
edge_cases.error_condition: `git push --force` fails after tracking comment has already been posted

edge_cases.action: logs at ERROR: 'Error in feedback iteration for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: auto-commit failed — {exc}.'; skips the force-push; calls `_cleanup_feedback_worktree` in the finally block
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; af:pr label remains

edge_cases.action: uses `git push --force` (not `--force-with-lease`) because the previous worktree was destroyed and the local ref is stale; `--force-with-lease` would fail in this scenario

user_story.goal: ensure no orphaned git worktrees accumulate on the filesystem when feedback iterations fail
user_story.benefit: disk space is not exhausted and subsequent git operations are not blocked by stale worktrees

acceptance_criteria.action: wraps all feedback iteration operations (fetch through force-push) in a try/finally block that calls `_cleanup_feedback_worktree(issue.number)` unconditionally on exit
silently no-ops and logs at DEBUG: 'Feedback worktree not found for issue #{n} — skipping cleanup.' without raising any exception
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; no exception is raised
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the worktree directory `worktrees/feedback-{issue_number}` does not exist

edge_cases.action: logs the failure at WARNING and does not re-raise; the finally block must not mask the original exception by raising a secondary one
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; original exception from the try block propagates normally
edge_cases.error_condition: the worktree removal command itself fails (e.g., permission error)

requirements.title: Structured logging for PR feedback loop

user_story.goal: monitor PR feedback loop health through structured log output
user_story.benefit: all state transitions and failures are observable without adding new state counters

acceptance_criteria.action: emits INFO logs for: PR merged and issue closed; PR closed without merge; re-entry triggered by CI; re-entry triggered by review; retry limit reached; feedback iteration complete
emits WARNING logs for: missing or malformed tracking comment; ambiguous CI state; platform API error during polling phase; coder produced no changes; `git diff --name-only` failure
emits ERROR logs for: fetch failure; worktree creation failure; force-push failure; coder session exception; auto-commit failure; tracking comment post failure
emits DEBUG log when `_cleanup_feedback_worktree` is called for a non-existent directory
requires no new fields beyond the existing `issue_checks_completed` counter; all observability is provided via structured log lines

user_story.goal: implement PR feedback logic in a focused, composable module
user_story.benefit: the feedback module remains maintainable and does not complicate the FixPipeline class hierarchy

acceptance_criteria.action: defines `process_pr_issue`, `_check_pr_state`, `_check_ci_status`, `_check_reviews`, `_collect_feedback`, `_run_feedback_iteration`, `_setup_feedback_worktree`, and `_cleanup_feedback_worktree` as module-level functions; does not subclass `FixPipeline`

defines module-level string constants: `_FEEDBACK_ITERATION_MESSAGE`, `_NO_CHANGES_MESSAGE`, `_RETRY_LIMIT_MESSAGE`, `_FEEDBACK_COMMIT_MESSAGE`; imports `parse_tracking_comment`, `format_tracking_comment`, `PR_TRACKING_PATTERN`, `TriageResult`, `FixPipeline` from `agentfox.nightshift.fix_pipeline`

imports `PlatformProtocol`, `IssueResult`, `CheckResult`, `ReviewComment` from `afissues.protocol`; imports `LABEL_PR`, `LABEL_FIXED` from `afissues.labels`; imports `sanitise_branch_name` from `agentfox.nightshift.spec_builder`

is declared as `async def process_pr_issue(issue: IssueResult, config: NightShiftConfig, platform: PlatformProtocol, pipeline: FixPipeline) -> None` and receives a `FixPipeline` reference for composition
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None in all cases (success or skip)

user_story.goal: never double-process an issue that is already under PR monitoring
user_story.benefit: the fix pipeline and PR feedback loop operate on disjoint issue sets with no additional guard code

acceptance_criteria.action: ensures `af:fix` and `af:pr` are mutually exclusive on any issue at any time; spec 06 removes `af:fix` and adds `af:pr` when a PR is created; this spec removes `af:pr` when a PR is merged or closed without merge
does not select the issue via `list_issues_by_label(LABEL_FIX)` and never processes it
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the issue is invisible to the fix pipeline query

acceptance_criteria.action: removes `af:pr` from the issue and leaves the issue open without `af:fix`; the fix pipeline only re-picks the issue if `af:fix` is subsequently re-added by a human labeling action
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; issue is open with no nightshift labels
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a PR is closed without merge

correctness_properties.title: Retry limit is never exceeded
correctness_properties.for_any: issue with `attempt` read from tracking comment and `max_pr_retries` from config
correctness_properties.invariant: feedback re-entry (worktree creation, coder session, force-push) is only executed when `attempt <= max_pr_retries`; when `attempt > max_pr_retries`, only a limit-reached comment is posted

correctness_properties.title: af:pr and af:fix labels are mutually exclusive
correctness_properties.for_any: any GitHub issue managed by nightshift
correctness_properties.invariant: no issue carries both `af:pr` and `af:fix` simultaneously at any point during or after a nightshift operation

correctness_properties.title: Tracking comment is persisted before force-push
correctness_properties.for_any: any feedback iteration that completes the tracking comment step
correctness_properties.invariant: the incremented attempt counter tracking comment is posted to the issue before any force-push is attempted; if the force-push fails the counter remains visible on the issue

correctness_properties.title: Feedback worktree is always cleaned up
correctness_properties.for_any: any execution of _run_feedback_iteration regardless of success or failure
correctness_properties.invariant: _cleanup_feedback_worktree is called in a finally block; if the worktree directory does not exist, cleanup silently no-ops without raising

correctness_properties.title: CI and review re-entry paths are mutually exclusive
correctness_properties.invariant: _collect_feedback is called with exactly one trigger value ('ci' or 'review') and never both; CI failure in step 3 prevents step 4 from executing

correctness_properties.title: Poll cycle cap prevents excessive API usage
correctness_properties.for_any: any poll cycle fired by the pr-feedback EngineWorkStream
correctness_properties.invariant: at most `_MAX_PR_CHECKS` (5) issues are processed per cycle regardless of how many af:pr issues exist; older issues are always processed before newer ones

correctness_properties.title: Platform API errors during polling never post comments
correctness_properties.for_any: any platform API exception raised during the polling phase of process_pr_issue
correctness_properties.invariant: no comment is posted to the issue on polling-phase API failures; only a WARNING log is emitted and the issue is skipped

correctness_properties.title: max_pr_retries=0 disables all feedback iterations
correctness_properties.for_any: any feedback trigger when max_pr_retries is configured to 0
correctness_properties.invariant: no worktree is created, no coder session runs, and no force-push occurs; only the retry limit comment and INFO log are emitted

execution_paths.title: Merged PR detected and issue closed automatically

steps.action: fires the pr-feedback stream on the pr_check_interval schedule
calls platform.list_issues_by_label(LABEL_PR) and receives a list of open af:pr issues in oldest-first order
caps the list to _MAX_PR_CHECKS issues and awaits process_pr_issue() for the first issue
calls platform.list_issue_comments(issue.number) and finds the last comment matching PR_TRACKING_PATTERN
calls parse_tracking_comment on the matching comment to extract pr_number and attempt
calls platform.get_pr_state(pr_number) and receives PrState with merged=True
calls platform.assign_label(issue.number, LABEL_FIXED), platform.remove_label(issue.number, LABEL_PR), platform.close_issue(issue.number, 'PR #{pr_number} merged.')
logs at INFO: 'PR #{pr} merged for issue #{n}. Closed with af:fixed.' and returns
increments state.issue_checks_completed and proceeds to the next issue if any

execution_paths.title: CI failure triggers feedback re-entry and coder re-run

steps.action: fires the pr-feedback stream
lists af:pr issues and awaits process_pr_issue() for an open-PR issue
parses tracking comment to extract pr_number=42 and attempt=1
calls platform.get_pr_state(42) and receives state='open', merged=False
calls platform.get_pr_checks(42) and finds one CheckResult with conclusion='failure'
logs at INFO: 'Re-entry triggered for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: CI failure/timeout.' and returns re-entry signal
evaluates attempt=1 <= max_pr_retries=2 and proceeds
formats the failed CheckResult under ## CI Failures and returns a markdown string
runs git fetch origin fix/42-slug then git worktree add worktrees/feedback-42 on the fix branch
runs git diff --name-only integration_branch fix_branch to compute affected_files
constructs a synthetic TriageResult with issue title, affected_files, and issue body
builds system and task prompts with review_feedback=<ci_markdown>, prior_context='', knowledge_context=''
executes the coder session in the feedback worktree
calls format_tracking_comment(pr_number=42, attempt=2, pr_url='', message=_FEEDBACK_ITERATION_MESSAGE) and platform.add_issue_comment to post the updated tracking comment
computes the diff; finds non-empty changes
commits changes with message 'fix: <issue title> [nightshift feedback #2]'
runs git push --force on the fix branch to origin
logs at INFO: 'Feedback iteration 2 complete for issue #{n}, PR #42.'
removes the worktree at worktrees/feedback-42

execution_paths.title: Reviewer change request triggers feedback re-entry

steps.action: fires the pr-feedback stream
parses tracking comment and extracts pr_number and attempt
receives state='open' from get_pr_state; proceeds to CI check
all checks have conclusion='success'; returns pass-through signal to review check
calls platform.get_pr_reviews(pr_number); filters out DISMISSED reviews; latest active review has state='CHANGES_REQUESTED'
logs at INFO: 'Re-entry triggered for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: reviewer requested changes.' and returns re-entry signal
called with trigger='review'; formats reviewer user, body, state under ## Review Feedback
runs full feedback iteration: fetch, worktree, coder, tracking comment, force-push, cleanup

execution_paths.title: Retry limit reached — PR flagged for manual attention

steps.action: fires the pr-feedback stream
parses tracking comment and extracts attempt=3 with max_pr_retries=2
receives state='open'; proceeds to CI check
returns re-entry signal (CI failure detected)
evaluates attempt=3 > max_pr_retries=2 as True; stops re-entry
logs at INFO: 'Retry limit reached for issue #{n}, PR #{pr} (attempt 3/3). Needs manual attention.'
posts _RETRY_LIMIT_MESSAGE comment to the issue via platform.add_issue_comment
leaves af:pr label in place and returns None; no worktree is created

execution_paths.title: PR closed without merge — issue left open for manual triage

steps.action: fires the pr-feedback stream
parses tracking comment successfully
calls platform.get_pr_state(pr_number) and receives state='closed', merged=False
calls platform.add_issue_comment with 'PR #{pr_number} was closed without merging. Removing af:pr label for manual triage.'
calls platform.remove_label(issue.number, LABEL_PR); logs at INFO
returns None; issue is open without any af:pr or af:fixed label

execution_paths.title: Full end-to-end: nightshift daemon creates PR then detects merge and closes issue

steps.action: configures nightshift with merge_strategy='pr' and starts the daemon
initialises work streams including fix-pipeline and pr-feedback in priority order
fires; NightShiftEngine._drain_issues picks up a labeled af:fix issue and runs the fix pipeline
creates a PR on GitHub; removes af:fix; adds af:pr; posts initial tracking comment with attempt=1 to the issue
fires after pr_check_interval seconds; NightShiftEngine._check_open_prs lists af:pr issues
parses tracking comment from the issue; extracts pr_number and attempt=1
calls platform.get_pr_state; human has merged the PR; receives merged=True
assigns af:fixed label, removes af:pr label, closes issue with comment 'PR #{pr_number} merged.'
increments issue_checks_completed; cycle completes
observes the issue is closed with af:fixed label and the merge confirmation comment

execution_paths.title: Coder produces no changes during feedback iteration

steps.action: fires the pr-feedback stream; CI failure detected for an open PR
retry limit not exceeded; runs fetch and worktree setup
completes but produces no file changes in the worktree
posts updated tracking comment with incremented attempt counter before diff check
computes diff; diff is empty; skips force-push
posts _NO_CHANGES_MESSAGE comment to the issue via platform.add_issue_comment
logs at WARNING: 'Feedback iteration {attempt} for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: coder produced no changes.'
removes the feedback worktree; returns None

error_handling.condition: Platform API exception raised during the polling phase (get_pr_state, get_pr_checks, get_pr_reviews, list_issue_comments, or label operations)
error_handling.behavior: Log at WARNING with issue number, PR number, and exception message. Skip the issue for this poll cycle. Leave all labels intact. Post no comment to the issue. Retry on the next poll cycle.

error_handling.condition: Platform API exception raised mid-sequence during merged PR label transition (e.g., assign_label succeeds but close_issue raises)
error_handling.behavior: Log at WARNING. Skip the issue for this cycle. All three operations (assign_label, remove_label, close_issue) are idempotent at the GitHub API level; re-application on the next cycle is safe.

error_handling.condition: No tracking comment matching PR_TRACKING_PATTERN found on the issue, or parse_tracking_comment returns None (malformed comment)
error_handling.behavior: Log at WARNING: 'Skipped issue #{n}: no valid tracking comment found. Will retry next cycle.' Skip the issue. Leave af:pr label in place for retry on the next poll cycle. Post no comment.

error_handling.condition: git fetch origin <branch> fails during _setup_feedback_worktree (network error or branch not found on origin)
error_handling.behavior: Log at ERROR: 'Error in feedback iteration for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: git fetch failed — {exc}.' Skip the issue. Leave all labels intact. _cleanup_feedback_worktree silently no-ops in the finally block.

error_handling.condition: git worktree add fails after a successful fetch (disk space exhaustion, branch name conflict, or other git error)
error_handling.behavior: Log at ERROR: 'Error in feedback iteration for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: git worktree add failed — {exc}.' Skip the issue. Leave all labels intact. _cleanup_feedback_worktree silently no-ops in the finally block.

error_handling.condition: platform.add_issue_comment raises during tracking comment posting in step 5 of feedback re-entry
error_handling.behavior: Log at ERROR: 'Error in feedback iteration for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: failed to post tracking comment — {exc}.' Skip the force-push. Call _cleanup_feedback_worktree. Old attempt counter remains; next cycle re-triggers with the correct counter.

error_handling.condition: git push --force fails after tracking comment has been successfully posted
error_handling.behavior: Log at ERROR: 'Error in feedback iteration for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: git push --force failed — {exc}.' Call _cleanup_feedback_worktree in the finally block. Incremented attempt counter is already persisted. Leave af:pr label intact. Next cycle retries or hits the limit.

error_handling.condition: _run_coder_session raises an exception during the feedback iteration
error_handling.behavior: Log at ERROR: 'Error in feedback iteration for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: coder session raised — {exc}.' Skip the issue. Call _cleanup_feedback_worktree in the finally block. Leave all labels intact.
Log at ERROR: 'Error in feedback iteration for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: auto-commit failed — {exc}.' Skip the force-push. Call _cleanup_feedback_worktree in the finally block. Leave af:pr label intact.

error_handling.condition: All CI checks have conclusion in {cancelled, action_required, stale} with none having conclusion='success'
error_handling.behavior: Log at WARNING: 'Skipped issue #{n}, PR #{pr}: all checks in ambiguous state (cancelled/action_required/stale).' Skip the issue for this cycle. No re-entry is triggered.

error_handling.condition: _cleanup_feedback_worktree is called and the worktree directory does not exist
error_handling.behavior: Silently no-op. Log at DEBUG: 'Feedback worktree not found for issue #{n} — skipping cleanup.' Do not raise any exception.

error_handling.condition: git diff --name-only command fails or returns empty output when computing affected_files
error_handling.behavior: Default affected_files to []. Log at WARNING: 'git diff --name-only failed for issue #{n}, PR #{pr} — defaulting affected_files to [].' Continue the coder session with the empty list.
